result.reason: The clause adds the required annual frequency, business-hours, 30-day notice, confidentiality, independence, and no-system-access protections. However, the cost shift still applies to any “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than only an underpayment over 5%, so it does not reach the preferred or fallback position. It also unnecessarily relocates the cost provision and creates timing tension by requiring at least 30 days’ prior notice while requiring the audit to be permitted within 30 days after receipt.
